name: stringcase1.k
model:
class StringCase1 {
  text1:String
  text2:String

  req text1 = "Hello"

  req text2 = "Hello"
  areEqual:Bool

  req areEqual = (text1 = text2)

  req areEqual = true
  text3:String

  req text3 = "World"
  areDifferent:Bool

  req areDifferent = (text1 != text3)

  req areDifferent = true
}

main:StringCase1
smt:
; ================
; === Options: ===
; ================

(set-option :smt.macro-finder true)

; ======================
; === String Theory: ===
; ======================

; Z3 4.13.0+ requires explicit logic or theory declaration for strings
(set-logic ALL)

; ===========================
; === Built-in datatypes: ===
; ===========================

(define-sort Ref () Int)

(declare-datatypes (T1 T2) ((Tuple2 (mk-Tuple2 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)))))
(declare-datatypes (T1 T2 T3) ((Tuple3 (mk-Tuple3 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)(_3 T3)))))


; ===============================
; === User-defined datatypes: ===
; ===============================

(declare-datatypes () ((TopLevelDeclarations (mk-TopLevelDeclarations (main Ref)))))
(declare-datatypes () ((StringCase1 (mk-StringCase1 (text1 String)(text2 String)(areEqual Bool)(text3 String)(areDifferent Bool)))))

; =============
; === Heap: ===
; =============

(declare-datatypes () ((Any
  (lift-TopLevelDeclarations (sel-TopLevelDeclarations TopLevelDeclarations))
  (lift-StringCase1 (sel-StringCase1 StringCase1))
  null))
)

(declare-const heap (Array Ref Any))
(declare-const NULL$ String)
(declare-const NULL$Ref Ref)
(assert (= NULL$Ref (- 1)))

(define-fun deref ((ref Ref)) Any
  (select heap ref)
)

; ==========================================
; === Class specific is/deref-functions: ===
; ==========================================

(define-fun deref-is-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-TopLevelDeclarations (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) TopLevelDeclarations
  (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-StringCase1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-StringCase1 (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-StringCase1 ((this Ref)) StringCase1
  (sel-StringCase1 (deref this))
)

; ======================
; === Isa-functions: ===
; ======================

(define-fun deref-isa-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-TopLevelDeclarations this)
)

(define-fun deref-isa-StringCase1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-StringCase1 this)
)

; ================
; === Getters: ===
; ================

; -------------------------------------------
;   Getters for class TopLevelDeclarations:
; -------------------------------------------

; --- getters for TopLevelDeclarations.main: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations!main ((this Ref)) Ref
  (main (deref-TopLevelDeclarations this))
)

; ----------------------------------
;   Getters for class StringCase1:
; ----------------------------------

; --- getters for StringCase1.text1: ---

(define-fun StringCase1!text1 ((this Ref)) String
  (text1 (deref-StringCase1 this))
)

; --- getters for StringCase1.text2: ---

(define-fun StringCase1!text2 ((this Ref)) String
  (text2 (deref-StringCase1 this))
)

; --- getters for StringCase1.areEqual: ---

(define-fun StringCase1!areEqual ((this Ref)) Bool
  (areEqual (deref-StringCase1 this))
)

; --- getters for StringCase1.text3: ---

(define-fun StringCase1!text3 ((this Ref)) String
  (text3 (deref-StringCase1 this))
)

; --- getters for StringCase1.areDifferent: ---

(define-fun StringCase1!areDifferent ((this Ref)) Bool
  (areDifferent (deref-StringCase1 this))
)

; ================
; === Methods: ===
; ================

; ===================
; === Invariants: ===
; ===================

; ---------------------------------------------
;   Invariant for class TopLevelDeclarations:
; ---------------------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-0-TopLevelDeclarations TopLevelDeclarations)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-isa-StringCase1 (TopLevelDeclarations!main this))
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv1 0) :named _xkassert0))



; ------------------------------------
;   Invariant for class StringCase1:
; ------------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-1-StringCase1 StringCase1)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun StringCase1.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (StringCase1!text1 this) "Hello")
)

(assert (! (StringCase1.inv1 1) :named _xkassert1))

; --- Invariant 2: ---

(define-fun StringCase1.inv2 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (StringCase1!text2 this) "Hello")
)

(assert (! (StringCase1.inv2 1) :named _xkassert2))

; --- Invariant 3: ---

(define-fun StringCase1.inv3 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (StringCase1!areEqual this) (= (StringCase1!text1 this) (StringCase1!text2 this)))
)

(assert (! (StringCase1.inv3 1) :named _xkassert3))

; --- Invariant 4: ---

(define-fun StringCase1.inv4 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (StringCase1!areEqual this) true)
)

(assert (! (StringCase1.inv4 1) :named _xkassert4))

; --- Invariant 5: ---

(define-fun StringCase1.inv5 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (StringCase1!text3 this) "World")
)

(assert (! (StringCase1.inv5 1) :named _xkassert5))

; --- Invariant 6: ---

(define-fun StringCase1.inv6 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (StringCase1!areDifferent this) (not (= (StringCase1!text1 this) (StringCase1!text3 this))))
)

(assert (! (StringCase1.inv6 1) :named _xkassert6))

; --- Invariant 7: ---

(define-fun StringCase1.inv7 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (StringCase1!areDifferent this) true)
)

(assert (! (StringCase1.inv7 1) :named _xkassert7))




; ======================
; === Generate heap: ===
; ======================

(assert
  (=
    heap
    (store(store
      ((as const (Array Ref Any)) null)
        0 (lift-TopLevelDeclarations const-0-TopLevelDeclarations))
        1 (lift-StringCase1 const-1-StringCase1))
  )
)
smtModel:
(define-fun const-1-StringCase1 () StringCase1
  (mk-StringCase1 "Hello" "Hello" true "World" true))
(define-fun const-0-TopLevelDeclarations () TopLevelDeclarations
  (mk-TopLevelDeclarations 1))
(define-fun _xkassert7 () Bool
  (= (areDifferent (sel-StringCase1 (select heap 1))) true))
(define-fun _xkassert2 () Bool
  (= (text2 (sel-StringCase1 (select heap 1))) "Hello"))
(define-fun _xkassert5 () Bool
  (= (text3 (sel-StringCase1 (select heap 1))) "World"))
(define-fun _xkassert0 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select heap (main (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (select heap 0))))))
  (is-lift-StringCase1 a!1)))
(define-fun _xkassert3 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (= (text1 (sel-StringCase1 (select heap 1)))
              (text2 (sel-StringCase1 (select heap 1))))))
  (= (areEqual (sel-StringCase1 (select heap 1))) a!1)))
(define-fun _xkassert6 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (= (text1 (sel-StringCase1 (select heap 1)))
              (text3 (sel-StringCase1 (select heap 1))))))
  (= (areDifferent (sel-StringCase1 (select heap 1))) (not a!1))))
(define-fun _xkassert1 () Bool
  (= (text1 (sel-StringCase1 (select heap 1))) "Hello"))
(define-fun _xkassert4 () Bool
  (= (areEqual (sel-StringCase1 (select heap 1))) true))
(define-fun NULL$Ref () Int
  (- 1))
(define-fun heap () (Array Int Any)
  (store (store ((as const (Array Int Any)) null)
              0
              (lift-TopLevelDeclarations (mk-TopLevelDeclarations 1)))
       1
       (lift-StringCase1 (mk-StringCase1 "Hello" "Hello" true "World" true))))
